description: Sends a message or reaction to a specific Chat conversation. Send either `encoded_message_create_event`, an encrypted event built with the Chat XDK, or `content`, a plaintext message or reaction that is sent unencrypted. Use the recipient's `receives_your_chat` user field to choose: `encrypted` takes `encoded_message_create_event`, `unencrypted` takes `content`, and `none` means the recipient cannot be messaged. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. A recipient who cannot be messaged (closed inbox, system/notification account, or a 1:1 block) returns HTTP 403 with type https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-not-messageable.

event_id.description: ID of the message event the reaction is on.
